title: aidd list --upkeep --json
description: The upkeep that is due, from what aidd already knows: each item with the command or skill it goes to. A person decides what to do; aidd decides nothing. A new optional key may be added in a minor release; a renamed or removed key bumps `schema_version`.

schema_version.description: The version of this output's shape.

items.description: Each item that is due, in a fixed order by kind.

what.description: What is due, in a sentence.

where.description: The file it is about, repo-relative, or null.

due.description: The date it was or is due, `YYYY-MM-DD`, or null when it has none.

route.description: Where the item goes: a standards update, the release-rollout skill's flag cleanup, a postmortem and its backfill, a flaky test's quarantine, a waiver's renewal or the rule met, a runbook drill, or the fix `aidd doctor` names.

how.description: The command or skill that takes it, in words.
